note: Sanger is the small separate campground beside the Sanger boat landing at Cross Ranch State Park on the Missouri River, under cottonwoods: gravel electric sites on the west side of the lane, short grass primitive sites on the east, and a primitive group site by the landing; small picnic shelter without electricity. Showers, flush toilets and the dump station are at the main park. --Claude
summary: reserveNDparks lists 16 Sanger units: 7 standard 30-amp sites with 30-40 ft gravel pads ($25, $30 Sat), 8 primitive grass sites 10-18 ft ($15), 1 primitive group site 75 ft ($15/unit); no water or sewer at sites. Fees confirmed (manual); hookups/sites/facilities/booking now manual; note rewritten. Pin on the campground; not waterfront stands for the RV sites.
flags: POLICY ROW: consistent. Saturday +$5 confirmed on standard (repo samples 2026-10-24 and 2027-06-19; live grid read for 2027-06-15 matches the park page). The stored fees.reservation_fee 6 and fees.entrance duplicate the state:ND row; the park page does not restate them, left as stored.

BASE RATE question: primitive group site 66 ('Primitive Group Site 1-3 Units', 75-ft gravel pad, $15 a unit) is bookable for one unit, so a 23-ft rig could book $15 there. Kept $25 (the standard sites) as the base; a reviewer may prefer $15.
Max length: the reservation system posts 30-40 ft on the standard sites (not a uniform placeholder); all 7 take 23 ft. None of the 8 primitive sites does (10-18 ft).

Season: stored year_round with the limited-service note stands; the limited-service page still reads 'Water in the Sanger campground will be shut off on November 1. Vault toilet at Sanger campground will be shut down on December 1.' No 2026/2027 campground dates are published beyond that.

Waterfront: not waterfront stands. The standard sites sit ~80 m from the river behind the primitive row and a belt of trees and tall grass. Group site 66 is ~20 m from the shore on the open sand by the boat landing (day-use ramp area): a group site, not a waterfront call for the campground.
